mode.title: Mode
mode.description: New carriers: companies that registered a USDOT number in the last N days (lead feed). Lookup: specific USDOT numbers, MC numbers or company names.
enumTitles: Lookup by DOT, MC or name

addedWithinDays.title: Registered within (days)
addedWithinDays.description: New mode: carriers whose USDOT registration was added in the last N days. The FMCSA file lags 1-2 days.

states.title: States
states.description: Two-letter state codes of the physical address, e.g. TX, CA, FL. Empty = all states.

mcNumbers.title: MC / docket numbers (lookup)
mcNumbers.description: Lookup mode: MC, MX or FF docket numbers (digits only or with prefix).

companyNames.title: Company names (lookup)
companyNames.description: Lookup mode: legal or DBA name contains this text (case insensitive). Up to 20.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Interstate carriers cross state lines (need USDOT + often MC authority). Intrastate stay in one state.

authorizedForHireOnly.title: For-hire carriers only
authorizedForHireOnly.description: Only carriers that haul for others (authorized for hire), not private fleets.

cargoTypes.title: Cargo types
cargoTypes.description: Keep carriers that haul any of these. Options: general_freight, household_goods, metal_sheets_coils, motor_vehicles, driveaway_towaway, logs_poles_lumber, building_materials, mobile_homes, machinery_large_objects, fresh_produce, liquids_gases, intermodal_containers, passengers, oilfield_equipment, livestock, grain_feed_hay, coal_coke, meat, garbage_refuse, us_mail, chemicals, dry_bulk, refrigerated_food, beverages, paper_products, utilities, agricultural_supplies, construction, water_well, other.

hazmatOnly.title: Hazmat carriers only
hazmatOnly.description: Only carriers flagged as hazardous materials carriers.

activeOnly.title: Active only
activeOnly.description: New mode: skip inactive and pending registrations.

requireEmail.title: Require email
requireEmail.description: Only carriers with an email on file.

requirePhone.title: Require phone
requirePhone.description: Only carriers with a phone on file.

maxRows.title: Max carriers
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned (newest first). Controls cost.
